package handlers

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestGeneratedCourseHandlerAcceptsPayloadAboveLegacyTwoMiBLimit(t *testing.T) {
	body := `{"description":"` + strings.Repeat("x", 3<<20) + `"}`
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/generated-courses", strings.NewReader(body))
	request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()

	(GeneratedCourseHandler{}).EnsureCourse(response, request)

	if response.Code != http.StatusUnprocessableEntity {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d want=%d body=%s", response.Code, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, response.Body.String())
	}
}
